programme.title: The Hub With Wang Guan
programme.desc: The Hub with Wang Guan covers hot-button geopolitical and economic issues, as well as interesting stories and trends in culture, education, technology and lifestyle. It aims to connect people, cultures and societies across the East and the West. The program features dynamic designs, fast pace and rich visuals to keep viewers engaged. It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on what’s relevant in China and the world.

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Os irmãos JP e Mikey tiveram uma infância complicada. Atualmente, o primeiro é dono de uma empresa de construção mas o segundo é um pequeno mafioso, que é raptado pelo criminoso Eddie King. JP vai arriscar tudo para resgatar o irmão, que sempre fez tudo por ele.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Sequestro Nas Montanhas
programme.desc: Um grupo de cinco montanhistas a fazer caminhadas e escaladas nas Terras Altas da Escócia descobre uma menina sérvia enterrada numa pequena câmara numa zona deserta, e vê-se apanhado num aterrorizante jogo de gato e rato com os sequestradores da jovem.

programme.title: Delatora
programme.desc: Kathy Bolkovac é uma agente do Nebraska que vai trabalhar para as Nações Unidas como pacificadora na Bósnia. Só que a sua vontade de ajudar é arrasada ao deparar-se com uma vasta rede de corrupção e tráfico sexual encoberta pela instituição.

programme.title: Interrogation - Explosões Em Cadeia
programme.desc: Quando o FBI recebe a ameaça de que uma bomba vai explodir na cidade, um interrogador e uma informática envolvem-se numa série de jogos mentais com um criminoso, lutando contra o tempo para desvendar os seus verdadeiros motivos e impedir o desastre.

programme.title: Belle
programme.desc: Suzu é uma discreta estudante japonesa de 17 anos que um dia entra em “U”, um universo virtual com cinco mil milhões de membros, onde deixa de ser Suzu para ser Belle, uma cantora mundialmente famosa. Aí conhece uma criatura misteriosa com a qual embarca numa viagem de aventuras, desafios e amor.

programme.title: Rostos Na Multidão
programme.desc: Anna testemunhou o crime de um serial killer, caiu de uma ponte e ficou em coma por uma semana. Quando acorda, é-lhe diagnosticada prosopagnosia, a incapacidade de reconhecer rostos, o que se torna muito complicado quando o assassino se aproxima para tentar matá-la.

programme.title: Vencer A Qualquer Preço
programme.desc: Um jornalista irlandês da área desportiva tem a forte suspeita de que as prestações do ciclista Lance Armstrong nas vitórias da Volta à França foram conseguidas à base de substâncias proibidas, o que o leva a procurar pistas que hão de revelar toda a verdade sobre o atleta.

programme.title: Send It: Uma História Radical
programme.desc: A vida de um praticante de desportos radicais muda para sempre ao deixar as suas simples raízes do Texas para competir no campeonato de kiteboarding mais prestigiado do mundo. Ao longo do caminho, uma jovem vai desafiá-lo a ir muito para lá da sua zona de conforto.

programme.title: No Lugar Errado
programme.desc: Um “cozinheiro” de metanfetaminas persegue o ex-chefe de polícia de uma pequena cidade a fim de o silenciar antes que ele testemunhe contra a sua família, só que acaba por ver-se confrontado com muito mais do que o que estava à espera.

programme.title: Réplicas
programme.desc: William Foster é um neurocientista genial cuja mulher e os três filhos morrem num acidente de carro. Secretamente, ele vai tentar clonar os seus corpos criando réplicas, mas vai ter de fazer uma escolha radical: ele só consegue trazer três dos seus quatro familiares de volta à vida.

programme.title: Jogo De Risco
programme.desc: Richie Furst financia as suas propinas da faculdade a jogar póquer na internet. Quando um dia é vigarizado, viaja até à Costa Rica para confrontar o responsável, Ivan Block, mas acaba por ser integrado na operação e viver uma vida de luxo, sem ter a noção do nível de ilegalidade que está a cometer.

programme.title: Ted
programme.desc: Como resultado de um desejo de infância, Ted, o ursinho de peluche de John Bennett, ganhou vida e ambos se tornaram inseparáveis pela vida fora. Só que a amizade que os une vai ser posta à prova quando a namorada de John quer fazer evoluir a relação.

programme.title: Her Smell - A Música Nas Veias
programme.desc: Uma cantora de punk rock auto-destrutiva luta por se manter sóbria, enquanto tenta recuperar a inspiração e a criatividade que catapultou a sua banda para o sucesso.

programme.title: Faz-Te Homem
programme.desc: Quando o milionário James King é condenado à prisão por fraude, o juiz dá-lhe 30 dias para pôr os seus assuntos em ordem e ele pede a Darnell Lewis que o prepare para uma vida atrás das grades. Só que ele não sabe que Darnell é um homem honesto e que vai ter de fingir para o ajudar.

programme.title: Wilde
programme.desc: A história de Oscar Wilde, o genial poeta e dramaturgo, que vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando percebe que é homossexual.

programme.title: Uma Boa Menina Como Tu
programme.desc: Depois de ser acusada pelo ex-namorado de não ter qualquer interesse em sexo, uma violinista cria uma arrojada lista de tarefas para conseguir ultrapassar os seus problemas com a intimidade.

programme.title: Sem Tempo A Perder
programme.desc: Em Lyon, em 1942, um pequeno grupo resistentes franceses usa a rádio para transmitir mensagens de esperança aos outros sobreviventes, tentando não ser descobertos pela Gestapo.

programme.title: Um Lugar Especial
programme.desc: Monty Wildhorn, um escritor de westerns alcoólico, perdeu a força criativa. Quando o sobrinho o convence a passar o verão em Belle Isle, ele começa a tornar-se amigo de uma mãe solteira e das suas três filhas, que lhe vão dar inspiração para começar a escrever outra vez.

programme.title: O Mauritano
programme.desc: Mohamedou Ould Slahi é detido pelo governo dos EUA logo a seguir ao 11 de Setembro, e é encarcerado em Guantánamo sem julgamento durante anos. Os seus únicos aliados são a advogada de defesa Nancy Hollander e a sua associada Teri Duncan que tentam lutar por justiça e descobrir toda a verdade.

programme.title: Sou O Teu Homem
programme.desc: Para obter fundos de pesquisa para os seus estudos, uma cientista aceita uma oferta para participar numa experiência extraordinária: durante três semanas, ela deve viver com um robô humanoide, criado para fazê-la feliz.

programme.title: Ted
programme.desc: Como resultado de um desejo de infância, Ted, o ursinho de peluche de John Bennett, ganhou vida e ambos se tornaram inseparáveis pela vida fora. Só que a amizade que os une vai ser posta à prova quando a namorada de John quer fazer evoluir a relação.

programme.title: Ted 2
programme.desc: A viver finalmente em casal com Tami-Lynn, o ursinho Ted quer constituir família e ter filhos. O problema será provar em tribunal que ele é qualificado para ser pai. Mais que isso: que é mesmo uma pessoa e não um mero urso de peluche.

programme.title: A Linha Do Horizonte
programme.desc: O piloto de um pequeno avião tem um ataque cardíaco em pleno voo rumo a uma ilha tropical. Para salvarem as suas vidas, Sara e Jackson, um casal de ex-namorados, terão de conseguir manter a aeronave no ar e encontrar o caminho de regresso a terra…

programme.title: O Coletivo
programme.desc: Um jovem recruta para uma misteriosa agência de assassinos torna-se um pária na sua primeira missão, rastreando um perigoso grupo de traficantes de pessoas.

programme.title: Pequeno Grande Guerreiro
programme.desc: Um velho soldado raso e um jovem general de um estado rival são os únicos sobreviventes de uma batalha terrível. O primeiro decide então raptar o segundo e levá-lo numa longa jornada cheia de peripécias para recolher a recompensa que lhe é devida.

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: Sofia é uma acompanhante de luxo que trabalha em casa e apresenta-se aos clientes como Manuela. Jano é seu cliente e apresenta-se como Hugo. Quem são Sofia e Jano? Nenhum deles é quem parece ser…

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: Eu, Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross é um detetive de homicídios de Detroit que vai ser levado a todos os limites físicos e morais qusndo tem de lidar com um assassino contratado que se especializa em dor e tortura.

programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Das Rheingold is the prologue to Richard Wagner's Ring Cycle. This rendition (2003) features the Staatsoper Stuttgart under the baton of conductor Lothar Zagrosek. Tonight’s soloists are Wolfgang Probst, Motti Kastón, Bernhard Schneider, Robert Künzli, Esa Ruuttunen, Eberhard Francesco Lorenz and Roland Bracht.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Bernhard Haitink conducts the Berlin Philharmonic and the Ernst Senff Choir in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2. This concert took place at the Berliner Philharmonie in 1992. The final chorus of Mahler's beautiful and impressive second symphony never fails to move its listeners.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Bach - The Well-Tempered Clavier No. 24
programme.desc: In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846–869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011
programme.desc: At St. Bartholomew Church in Dornheim, Germany, where composer Johann Sebastian Bach married his first wife Maria Barbara, renowned Dutch cellist Anner Bijlsma performs the composer's Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011. It is likely Bach wrote his collection of six Suites for unaccompanied cello during the years 1717-1723.

programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of 'Overture Rosamunde' (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, the Netherlands in 2015. Schubert initially composed the Overture for Georg Ernst von hofmann's play 'Die Zauberharfe' ('The Magic Harp'), which premiered on August 19, 1820.

programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 100
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Mozart - Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622
programme.desc: Conductor Marien van Staalen leads Amadeus Ensemble Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622. Henk de Graaf is the featured soloist. This performance was recorded at St. Nicholas Church in Vollenhove, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed Symphony No.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano plays Brahms and Beethoven
programme.desc: In this recital, Roberto Giordano plays the Six Pieces for Piano, op. 118 of Brahms, a collection completed in 1893 and dedicated to Clara Schumann who will be the penultimate produced by the composer during his lifetime. The concert program also includes two Beethoven sonatas, the famous Moonlight Sonata No. 14, op. 27, and Sonata No. 31, op. 110, one of the last sonatas signed by the composer.

programme.title: PIAM - Final: Beethoven and Brahms
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Live in Aix-en-Provence
programme.desc: The shy and elusive Grigroy Sokolov is one of the greatest pianists of our time. His performances leave critics and audiences alike speechless, like they don't quite believe what they have just experienced. In 2015, he played a beautiful recital with works by Johann Sebastian Bach, Ludwig van Beethoven, Franz Schubert, Frédéric Chopin, and Claude Debussy that took place at the Festival La Roque D'Anthéron in Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Ravel by Cherkaoui/Verbruggen
programme.desc: The Royal Ballet Flanders performs a beautiful program with ballets by choreographers Sidi Larbi Cherkaoui and Jeroen Verbruggen. The Symphonic Orchestra of the Opera Vlaanderen is conducted by Yannis Pouspourikas. Ravel remains a source of inspiration for many choreographers. Cherkaoui and rising talent Verbruggen take their vision of Ravel's music to the stage with the Ballet Flanders.

programme.title: Works by Smetana, Janácek, Suk and Dvorák
programme.desc: Musicians of the Reina Sofía School of Music pay tribute to the rich musical heritage of Czechia in this chamber concert. The program features Bedrich Smetana’s Piano Trio in G minor, performed by violinist Eduard Kollert, cellist Célia Garetti Nicole, and pianist Mariam Chitanava. Pianist Natalie Schwamova takes the stage for Leoš Janácek’s Piano Sonata 1.X.

programme.title: Stravinsky, Webern and Debussy
programme.desc: Today’s Brussels Philharmonic concert focuses on the diverse musical styles that characterized the first half of the 20th century. In addition to the impressionism of Claude Debussy's Jeux (1913), conductor Michel Tabachnik's ensemble focuses on one of the leading composers of modern music: Igor Stravinsky. His first ballet music, Firebird (1910), is a highlight of the concert.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio “Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno” (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris.

programme.title: Villa-Lobos - String Quartet No. 17
programme.desc: Quarteto Radamés Gnattali performs Heitor Villa-Lobos's String Quartet No. 17 at the Palácio das Laranjeiras in Rio de Janiero, Brasil. The ensemble was founded in 2006 and consists of Carla Rincón and Francisco Roa (violins), Fernando Thebaldi (viola), and Hugo Pilger (cello). The quartet, which specializes in Brazilian music, focuses on educational activities.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2004 - Tchaikovsky night
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker and Lang Lang under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Baroque Christmas Concert
programme.desc: This splendid Christmas concert was recorded live from the Freiburg Cathedral in 1999. It features soprano Barbara Bonney, recognized worldwide for the clarity of her voice and the precision of her diction, and the baritone Matthias Goerne, one of the most promising singers of his generation.

programme.title: Rota - The Godfather Suite
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono and Bernard Herrmann.

programme.title: Koroliov plays Bach’s Goldberg Variations
programme.desc: The pianist Evgeni Koroliov interprets J. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) as part of the Leipzig Bachfest. This work was originally composed for the harpsichord, and includes an aria and 30 variations. Published for the first time in 1741, the Goldberg Variations are considered one of the most important examples of the 'theme with variations' form.

programme.title: Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 And 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: Maestro Jaap van Zweden conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 in D minor, Op. 47. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, on March 9, 2016.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists of the Berliner Philharmoniker
programme.desc: Since 1972 the 12 Cellists of the Berliner Philharmoniker have been a prominent institution in international musical life. Listeners around the world are invariably fascinated by the wide range of the unique and intoxicating timbres that these twelve cellos can produce, whether they are playing classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde. Their mixture of seriousness and humour, of depth and lightness, appeals to audiences of all ages.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 58
programme.desc: In time for his 65th birthday in 2007, pianist Daniel Barenboim rounded off a cycle of Ludwig van Beethoven piano concertos. Recorded live at the Klavier-Festival Ruhr in May 2007, this recording reflects both a very individual and unusual reading of Beethoven’s music and Barenboim's life-long dedication to the composer. Beethoven’s masterpieces have been a key part of Barenboim’s repertoire throughout his career.

programme.title: Dufay: A Burgundian in Italy
programme.desc: The career of Guillaume Dufay – figurehead of Burgundian polyphony – begins in Italy. He seems to have particularly strong ties with Florence and her finest artists. Graindelavoix draws inspiration from this chapter in Dufay’s career in order to breathe new life into his dance-like oeuvre. Dufay’s pièce de résistance is of course included: Nuper rosarum flores, the motet used for the dedication of the cathedral of Florence.

programme.title: Cleveland Orchestra - Centennial Celebration
programme.desc: For the Anniversary Gala, Cleveland Orchestra Music Director Franz Welser-Möst led a program featuring pianist Lang Lang as soloist. The program offered works touching on more than a century of Viennese musical traditions with Lang Lang performing Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 24. The pianist made his Cleveland Orchestra debut in 2000 at Blossom Music Center and most recently performed with the Orchestra in 2014 at Severance Hall.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: A Mozart Celebration from Berlin
programme.desc: Performed in the grandeur of Berlin's foremost opera house, the Staatsoper Unter den Linden, the Mozart Celebration is dedicated to the life's work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. This one-time-only gala concert features exuberant Mozart pieces, performed by some of the world’s leading singers and musicians. Conductor Julien Salemkour leads these beautiful performances played by the Staatskapelle Berlin.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 73
programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music.

programme.title: How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker at the Easter Festival in Baden-Baden, 2015. On the program is Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68. The composer wrote his Symphony No. 6 between 1802 and 1808. Nicknamed 'Pastoral Symphony,' this piece is one of the few examples of program music for the German composer.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Concerto
programme.desc: Israeli violinist Itzhak Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic perform Johannes Brahms' Violin Concerto (1833-1897) under the direction of Daniel Barenboim. After Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Brahms' piece is probably the most famous German Violin Concerto ever written. These two works have much in common, especially the tone in D major in which they were composed.

programme.title: Monteverdi - Madrigals, Book I
programme.desc: Italian composer Claudio Monteverdi (1567-1643) composed nine books of madrigals in half a century, which helped transform the genre from the polyphonic, a cappella madrigals of the late Renaissance to the ‘concertato’ madrigals of the early Baroque, shifting the style’s focus to the ability of music to express emotions contained in a text.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Italian conductor Beatrice Venezi leads the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est and the Choeur de l'Opéra-Théâtre de Metz Métropole in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s tragic opera Madama Butterfly (1904). The story revolves around Cio-Cio-San, the young Japanese geisha ‘Butterfly’ who marries the visiting American officer Pinkerton. Faithfully awaiting his return, she cannot accept that Pinkerton has abandoned her.

programme.title: Waldbuhne 1998: Latin American Night
programme.desc: Pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim, Argentina's most famous musician, brings a Latin American flavour to the Berlin Philharmonic's 1998 concert at the Waldbühne amphitheater. The concert opens with Maurice Ravel's famous Boléro, a one-movement composition for orchestra originally composed as a ballet.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Luís Represas sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Gente que escreve, compõe, pinta, encena, sempre no seu próprio mundo solitário, por vezes desconhecido de quem não vê TV, rádio, internet, exposições, passagens de modelos ou de quem não tem hábitos de leitura. De Macau a Timor, de Angola a São Tomé e Príncipe, de Cabo Verde a Moçambique, da Guiné ao Brasil, estes autores têm um denominador comum: a língua portuguesa.

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal. .

programme.title: De Gente And De Vinha: Quinta Do Romeu - Entre A Terra E O Céu
programme.desc: De Gente And De Vinha, um retrato intimista do mundo vitivinícola, apresentado com o requinte e poesia do chef André Magalhães, percorre conversas e deambulações por entre quintas familiares, castas em extinção, tabernas e adegas centenárias. Desde 1874, entre o Douro e Trás-os-Montes, uma família produz um vinho histórico, ícone de sobrevivência, hoje exemplo de agricultura regenerativa. Na Quinta do Romeu, entre o Céu e a Terra.

programme.title: Estrada Nacional 2: Gois
programme.desc: 'Estrada Nacional 2 — O País Que Conta' - Durante sete semanas, o Conta Lá percorre a Estrada Nacional 2, de Chaves a Faro, atravessando 35 municípios. Uma emissão para dar visibilidade às pessoas, histórias, desafios e potencialidades que constroem o país todos os dias.

programme.title: Rita Ferro Rodrigues, Conversa Com… Francisca Nabinho
programme.desc: Conversas simples em que cada host convida o seu mundo de pessoas. Cada dia da semana um apresentador diferente e cada um define o seu conceito e escolhe os protagonistas em função do mesmo. De 2ª a 6ª Feira às 23h com 50 mins de duração, uma conversa sempre diferente. Esta semana, Rita Ferro Rodrigues, CONVERSA COM...FRANCISCA NABINHO. Francisca Nabinho é uma das vozes emergentes mais entusiasmantes do design nacional.

programme.title: Juca
programme.desc: “Juca” , apresentado por Júlio Magalhães, que chega ao ecrã de segunda a quinta-feira, entre as 21h00 e as 22h30. Num ambiente de late night descontraído, o jornalista deixa de lado o fato e a gravata para receber convidados sentados no sofá, em conversas próximas sobre atualidade, cultura, entretenimento e histórias de vida que ajudam a contar o país.

programme.title: Intercidades
programme.desc: O Intercidades é a viagem regional de fim de tarde do Conta Lá, conduzida por Rita Ferro Rodrigues, em estúdio, e uma vasta equipa de repórteres sempre em movimento pelas regiões. O programa distingue-se pelo olhar atento ao país, ligando estúdio e território em tempo real. O comboio vai parar nos vários concelhos e levar-nos até quem faz cada localidade — do café à escola, do campo à praça.

programme.title: A Letra: To-Zé Brito 'Papel Principal'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas no significado das letras e no processo criativo por trás das canções . 'Tozé Brito foi abordado pela amiga Adelaide Ferreira: queria uma canção para provocar um ex-namorado e 'superá-lo' ''Papel Principal'' ganhou vida própria, mil interpretações e reptos de anónimos.

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Aguiar Da Beira
programme.desc: Em Aguiar da Beira, a feira começa antes do sol nascer e o fumo das grelhas mistura-se com a neblina da serra. Nesta terra de gente forte e mãos de trabalho, a vida faz-se de reencontros, bancas de fruta do pomar e conversas que aquecem mais do que o café.Neste episódio do “Feira Semanal”, Marcos Pinto mergulha no coração de uma feira que é ponto de encontro, palco de afetos e montra de tradição.

programme.title: Mete-Te Na Minha Vida: João Neto
programme.desc: Neste programa documental de uma hora, acompanhamos um dia completo na vida de uma pessoa, que pode ser uma celebridade, um artista, um artesão ou alguém anónimo, como um taxista. Da manhã à noite, a câmara observa as rotinas, os gestos e os momentos mais banais ou marcantes do quotidiano, revelando vidas que podem ser surpreendentemente diferentes — ou profundamente semelhantes — à do espectador.

programme.title: A Letra: Celina Piedade - 'Calimero E A Pêra Verde'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas no significado das letras e no processo criativo por trás das canções .“Calimero e a Pêra Verde” combina o tema tradicional alentejano “Pêra Verde”, quase esquecido desde os anos 1960, com “Calimero”, do grupo belga Naragonia.

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal. .

programme.title: Estrada Nacional 2: Sertã
programme.desc: 'Estrada Nacional 2 — O País Que Conta' - Durante sete semanas, o Conta Lá percorre a Estrada Nacional 2, de Chaves a Faro, atravessando 35 municípios. Uma emissão para dar visibilidade às pessoas, histórias, desafios e potencialidades que constroem o país todos os dias.

programme.title: Documentário: 1820 - Revolução Liberal
programme.desc: Este documentário faz um retrato do Portugal oitocentista nos alvores do liberalismo. Uma análise dos factos ocorridos no Porto a 24 de agosto de 1820, o perfil político e socio-económico de uma revolta e as suas implicações, num país sob o domínio estrangeiro com a Corte ausente no Brasil. A resposta de uma “elite”, o Sinédrio, ao absolutismo com a criação das primeiras eleições alargadas, das Cortes Constituintes e da 1.

programme.title: Intercidades
programme.desc: O Intercidades é a viagem regional de fim de tarde do Conta Lá, conduzida por Rita Ferro Rodrigues, em estúdio, e uma vasta equipa de repórteres sempre em movimento pelas regiões. O programa distingue-se pelo olhar atento ao país, ligando estúdio e território em tempo real. O comboio vai parar nos vários concelhos e levar-nos até quem faz cada localidade — do café à escola, do campo à praça.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 44
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 34
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 78
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 80
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 42
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: São Paulo Samba
programme.desc: An exceptional concert from Brazil: the Orquestra Sinfônica do Estado de São Paulo proves its position as the most important orchestra in Latin America. Conducted by charismatic Maestro John Neschling since 1997, the orchestra is defined by its emblematic interpretations of Latin American music.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Dance of Maya
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Christian Scott
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited’ tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: B.B. King: The King of the Blues in Stuttgart
programme.desc: This uptempo, funky performance proves that B.B. King, one of the Masters of the Blues Guitar has still got it. The band features some of today's best blues musicians playing all of B.B. King's classic songs.

programme.title: Os Capoeira - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.title: Jazzed Out London
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: 'Long Tall Dexter' Live in '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64?features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra And Bert Joris - Big Valses
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: LBT - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. Among the artists of 2019 is the German Leo Betzl Trio.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Klezmer to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Soul Makossa: Manu Dibango in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Manu Dibango, one of Africa’s biggest musical stars and top saxophonists, is an indispensable artist. He was one of the first African musicians to score a worldwide hit with his 1972 release “Soul Makossa”, paving the way for many other artists. The very concept of world music owes much to him.

programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Caetano Veloso, Aquele Frevo Axe
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Buddy Rich in 1978
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Art Blakey And The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Nica's Dream
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. programme.title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax’ took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival.

programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Greatest Lady Vocalists
programme.desc: Arguably the greatest lady vocalists of all time are featured in this superb compilation. These historic recordings from the 1950s and 1960s offer a unique overview of different approaches to jazz singing that helped define the genre. Watch Billie Holiday’s performance of “God Bless The Child” closely and learn what made her such an influential jazz and pop singer.

programme.title: Voyage
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Terrasson And Belmondo: À Nous Garo
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between two grandmasters of French jazz: pianist Jacky Terrasson and trumpeter Stéphane Belmondo. The two team up for an amazing concert in which jazz is combined with soul and a touch of chanson française.

programme.title: Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gilberto Gil: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Julie Campiche Quartet at the Hafensommer Festival
programme.desc: The use of the harp in jazz is quite rare, especially in modern groups that also incorporate electronic effects. The combination of a harp with more conventional jazz instruments and electronic manipulation makes the Julie Campiche Quartet a unique ensemble in today’s jazz world.

programme.title: Visions of Music: Going Back To New Orleans
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: Mr Gentle and Mr Cool
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Straight No Chaser
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Rolf Delfos
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: B.B. King Orchestra - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1979, legendary American blues guitarist B.B. King gave an unforgettable performance for the audience in The Hague.

programme.title: Moonlight Benjamin - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. programme.title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Backback
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the Backback Trio.

Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Gregory Porter and Metronomy - Paris
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Kim Hoorweg at BIRD, Rotterdam
programme.desc: After Dutch singer Kim Hoorweg landed her first record contract from Universal Music at the age of 14, her musical career took off and she became a well-known name in the Netherlands jazz community. Famous artists such as Candy Dulfer, Raul Midón, Metropole Orkest, and Gino Vannelli, to name a few, have already performed with the singer on numerous occasions.

programme.title: 'Long Tall Dexter' Live in '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64?features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 60
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features undefeated Paul 'The Punisher' Williams (33-0, 24 KOs) defending his WBO welterweight title against the dangerous Carlos 'El Indio' Quintana (24-1, 19 KOs).

programme.title: MEGA Fights In 60 T1 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features undefeated Andre Berto (21-0, 18 KOs) battling Miguel Angel Rodriguez, aka 'Miki', (29-2, 23 KOs)i for the vacant WBC Welterweight Title from the FedEx Forum in Memphis, Tennessee, USA on June 21, 2008.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T11 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the Men's Weapons as well as Girl's Forms and Team Demo highlights.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 38
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is the undefeated Keith Thurman facing off with Orlando Lora. A left hook and right uppercut combination ends this fight. Also on the card, action from former heavyweight champion James Kirkland.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T30 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 5, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Terunofuji, Meisei, Takakeisho and Asanoyama.

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Highlights from the 26th Karate Senior World Championships as top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, all converged on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world.

programme.title: MMA:30 T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: This episode is highlighted by a heartfelt interview with the legendary MMA Hall of Famer Tito Ortiz that shows you sides of the former champ you never knew from his childhood to his love of fishing to the man he is today. We stop by 'Cowboy' Donald Cerrone's ranch to see you don't need the flashiest training equipment to be a world class fighter. Plus Nate Marquardt gets his dream car and UFC ring girls bring us on a tour of a new gym.

programme.title: FS MMA T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! Dan Evensen fights Jeremiah 'Hacksaw' Constant. Constant is a game opponent and looks to make his mark against Evenson in Costa Rica.

Joélly nota que Lena mentiu para ela. Arminda e Ferette ficam sabendo por Zezé que a obra Três Graças será devolvida para seu verdadeiro dono. Gerluce fica preocupada ao saber que Joélly e Raul foram se encontrar com Lena.

Mariana e Brandão se beijam.

Onildo avisa a José, Teresa e Niara/Vera sobre o ocorrido com Tonho, e diz que Alika/Lúcia ficará com o rapaz. Onildo sonda Niara/Vera.

programme.title: Web of Lies T7 - Ep. 5

programme.title: Papo De Paddock
programme.desc: Programa de entrevistas que oferece uma visão única e privilegiada do mundo das corridas. Combinando análise técnica e curiosidades, cada episódio traz entrevistas exclusivas com pilotos, especialistas e personalidades de diversas categorias do automobilismo. O programa mergulha nos bastidores das competições, revelando detalhes e histórias que cativam os aficionados por velocidade.

programme.title: Show Business
programme.desc: Acompanhe entrevistas com personalidades do mundo empresarial, politico e cultural. Economia, negócios e administração pública são os temas principais abordados.

programme.title: Jornal Da Band
programme.desc: Jornalístico diário, com notícias do momento.

programme.title: Jantar O Quê?
programme.desc: Quando chega à noite, bate aquela vontade de desfrutar um momento gostoso, nesta hora, uma mesma dúvida nasce em muitos corações e estômagos diferentes: jantar o quê? Esta saborosa questão inspirou a criação do programa apresentado pela jornalista e chef de cozinha Larissa Januário. Em cada dia da semana, larissa vai ajudar os espectadores a fazer melhor escolha para o seu jantar.

programme.title: Canal Livre
programme.desc: Momento de entrevista e análise com personalidades do mundo político, econômico, cultural, esportivo, científico e empresarial.

programme.title: Acelerados
programme.desc: Tudo ligado à paixão por motores, velocidade e adrenalina você confere no acelerados.

programme.title: Depois Do Jogo
